name: Josie’s Rapture
source:
Josie Marsh died, She’d expected it. What she hadn’t expected was for a multibillion dollar research company to bring her back. The CEO is delighted, as are her family, overjoyed to be reunited with her. But something is not right with Josie, and it’s getting worse by the day.

[From [url=https://hollow-bone.itch.io/josies-rapture]itch.io[/url]]
